reason: My regulars already book and hear about events through my Instagram and WhatsApp, and that costs me nothing. I'm not putting a new startup's QR code on my tables and handing it my guest list when I don't know if it will be around next year.
objection: Who owns my guest data, and what happens to it and to my payments flow if this startup folds or starts selling my regulars' contacts to the place down the street that's also listed in their diner app?
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that the guest data is mine and exportable any time, plus a couple of respected Old Tbilisi or Vake venues already running it for a few months without problems.
